chapter.heading: A Psalm of Asaph.
chapter.v:
God standeth
in the congregation of God;He judgeth among the gods.

How long
will ye judge unjustly,And respect the persons of the wicked? [Selah

Judge the
poor and fatherless:Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

Rescue the
poor and needy:Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

They know
not, neither do they understand;They walk to and fro in darkness:All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

I said,
Ye are gods,And all of you sons of the Most High.

Nevertheless ye
shall die like men,And fall like one of the princes.

Arise, O
God, judge the earth;For thou shalt inherit all the nations.
